summary: Iter33 Phase-3 (Voice Assistant + Smart Insights + Report-by-Chat + LR WhatsApp Share) verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 iter33 tests + 5/5 new extras tests + 9/9 iter31+iter32 regression all pass (20/20). Frontend: (1) Dashboard shows AI Insights card [data-testid=dashboard-insights-card] with 5 Telugu-English bullets (insight-0..4), 'Updated 8/8/2026 · cached (6h)' timestamp, and [data-testid=insights-refresh-btn]. (2) /trips/new header renders green Voice button [data-testid=voice-btn-start] with label 'VOICE · వాయిస్'; clicking toggles to STOP state (verified — button re-rendered post-click). SpeechRecognition constructor available in browser. (3) /trips list: 10 rows each with [data-testid=share-lr-{tripId}] green WA button; click POSTs /api/trips/{id}/share-lr → 200 with whatsapp_url starting with https://wa.me/?text=, opens URL in new tab (window.open intercepted), and shows toast 'LR LR/26-27/00026 ready to share'. Auto-LR triggered inside share-lr (lr_number present in response). (4) AI chat bubble opens via [data-testid=ai-chat-open]; green PDF button [data-testid=ai-chat-report] POSTs /api/ai/report → 200 application/pdf and chat shows '📊 Report generated for: ...' message. Public LR URL downloadable without auth (verified: %PDF- prefix, >500 bytes). /api/files/public rejects non lr_shares/|public/ prefixes with 404.

minor.issue: Cached response omits `stats_snapshot` field (present only on fresh generation). Spec called for {insights, generated_at, stats_snapshot, cached} on every response — minor schema inconsistency. Frontend doesn't depend on it in cache mode, so no functional break.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Include `stats_snapshot` in cached /api/ai/insights response (currently only returned on fresh generation) to match spec — cosmetic; no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/files.py `/files/public/{obj_path:path}` correctly restricts to lr_shares/|public/ prefixes and is properly unauthenticated for share links — verified with 3 test cases including 2 negative prefix cases.
routers/ai.py /ai/report returns X-Report-Spec header with parsed JSON spec (verified). Report PDF properly stamped %PDF- with >500 bytes.

routers/trips.py /trips/{tid}/share-lr auto-triggers LR autogen when blank and returns the expected {public_url, whatsapp_url, whatsapp_text, lr_number} shape; whatsapp_url deeplink is fully URL-encoded and contains the public PDF URL.
VoiceTripButton clean toggle behavior — clicking swaps testid from voice-btn-start to STOP state (element re-rendered, tolerable UX pattern).
AIChatBubble green PDF button integration is clean: uses expected /ai/report endpoint and posts a chat receipt on success.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 Phase-3 flows verified via Playwright end-to-end incl. API interception)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral trips created & deleted by /app/backend/tests/test_iter33_ai_extensions.py (AP99WA0001) and test_iter33_extras.py (AP99WA0099). WA share button testing used existing seed trips; one auto-shared LR (LR/26-27/00026) generated as side-effect — non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter33 Phase-3 is fully green. Backend endpoints: POST /api/ai/parse-trip, GET/POST /api/ai/insights (+/refresh), POST /api/ai/report (with X-Report-Spec header), POST /api/trips/{tid}/share-lr, GET /api/files/public/{path} (unauth, restricted to lr_shares/|public/). Frontend testids: dashboard-insights-card, insights-refresh-btn, insight-0..N, voice-btn-start (toggles to STOP after click), share-lr-{tripId} on each /trips row, ai-chat-open (bubble toggle) & ai-chat-report (green PDF button). Emergent LLM key (gemini-3-flash-preview) is functional. Only very minor spec deviation: cached /ai/insights omits stats_snapshot.
